summary: This directory provides reusable form-related user interface components and their associated type definitions, specifically focusing on standardized form submission controls and managing their interactive states during form lifecycle events.
responsibilities: Defining the interface for form submission controls
Implementing standardized buttons for form actions
Managing UI state representations for submission progress and accessibility
relationships: The SubmitButtonProps define the expected configuration for components that handle form submission.
The DefaultSubmitButton consumes specific properties to visually reflect the submission status of a form.
designDecisions: Collocation of component logic with type definitions for improved discoverability
Centralized export of form-specific UI elements through an index module
State-driven rendering to communicate form submission status to the end user
